fusions.name: Gnaw Swarm
fusions.desc: Looses 5 small jaws at once, each dealing 3 damage. Holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Strip the Field
fusions.desc: Hurls a mass of jaws that deals 28 damage and bursts for 80% of it on every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Stripped Stores
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Crumbs Gathered
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.
